reviews.body:
🦸‍♂️ Approved on head 3ae89006.

Reviewed: TaskScope now carries the caller's origin session key and an explicit Administrative opt-in. taskMatchesScope requires OriginSessionKey == scope.SessionKey unless Administrative, which closes the cross-chat list/get/steer/cancel(id=all)/wait leak in #1525. All three announce-roster call sites plus announceTask are marked Administrative, so lifecycle summaries still cover the whole root tree. Persisted spawn(action=get) is session-checked via storedSessionKeyMatches. Nested spawns inherit scope from context with the same session key, so child agents still see their own subtree.

Verified: CI go/web/release-versioning SUCCESS; merge-tree vs current dev is clean; the new TestSpawnControlsStayInsideCallerSession covers list/get/steer/cancel/wait for both sessions, the empty-key non-wildcard case, and the administrative roster.

Suggestions (non-blocking): the PR checklist leaves go build ./... unchecked, worth ticking next time. Sessions that were persisted under an empty key stay reachable only from empty-key callers, which is the intended strict behavior.
